title: Launch-ready rollout timeline: motion polish, accessibility flows, and dev handoff
creator: Aisha Khan
description:
Background:
We are iterating on the Rollouts timeline view to improve scannability for customers monitoring canary/gradual rollouts, reduce time-to-resolution for failed steps, and make the component production-ready for Dedicated customers who rely on clear SLAs. This ticket covers final visual redlines, motion/transition polish, keyboard accessibility flows, and a developer handoff package (spec + QA checklist).

Scope:
- Finalize visual redlines for timeline lanes, stage indicators, and compact/expanded states.
- Define motion spec for state transitions (expand/collapse, step success->failure).
- Document keyboard navigation, focus states, and screen-reader announcements.
- Produce a dev handoff bundle: Figma frames, tokens list, CSS variable recommendations, and an annotated accessibility checklist.
- Run a short QA pass with Product and Eng to verify implementation fidelity.

Out of scope:
- Backend rollout orchestration changes (separate ENG ticket).
- New metrics visualizations beyond providing placeholders.

Success Metrics:
- 95% of critical keyboard flows pass internal a11y checklist during QA.
- Stakeholder sign-off (PM, Eng, Reliability) on the handoff package.
- Figma spec covers both compact tile and full-page timeline.

Deliverables:
- Redline frames (compact + expanded) with spacing tokens and accessible color contrast.
- Motion spec (duration, easing, interrupt behavior) with demo prototypes.
- Accessibility doc listing keystrokes, ARIA usage, and SR text.
- Dev-handoff ZIP (Figma links, PNG exports, CSS token mapping).
- QA checklist and a short smoke test plan for engineering.

Constraints & decisions:
- Contrast: we bumped label contrast to AA+ for small text after Reliability requested clearer failure states.
- Motion: keep durations under 200ms for critical state changes to avoid added latency when teams are triaging.
- Caching: timeline uses aggregated step state; we documented a fallback visual for stale data rather than showing empty states.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Design review comments addressed and annotated in Figma.
- Accessibility doc reviewed by Security & Compliance and a11y lead.
- Handoff contains token mapping and scss examples for the timeline component.
- QA checklist includes at least 12 test cases (keyboard, screen reader, color overrides, responsive).
